lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.title: Sea Turtle from Big Shapes
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.summary: Build a friendly sea turtle from one big shell, a small head and four easy flippers, then add color.
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.step.shell_a: Start with one big soft oval for the shell, then add a small rounded head beside it.
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.help.shell_a: Make the shell the biggest shape and leave open space near one end for the head.
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.complete.she: Great! Your turtle already has a big shell and a head.
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.step.big_fli: Add four broad flippers around the shell. They can be simple curved paddles.
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.help.big_fli: Keep the flippers big and easy to see. Two can sit above the shell and two below.
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.complete.big: Nice big flippers. Your turtle is ready to swim.
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.step.friendl: Add an inner shell line, one eye and a tiny smile.
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.help.friendl: Keep the details simple. The big shapes should stay easy to see.
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.complete.fri: Your friendly sea turtle is complete.
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.coloring.she: Choose a color for the big shell.
lesson.sea_turtle_big_shell.coloring.hea: Now add a color to the turtle head.
